title: Genome-wide Association Study of Pituitary Tumors
brief_summary: Pituitary adenomas is a very common disease, but the cause and genetics hasn't been identified. The investigators are going to use genome-wide association study to identify genes that may be related to pituitary adenomas.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients diagnosed with pituitary adenomas

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients with a family history of endocrine tumors
study_population: Patients diagnosed with pituitary adenomas and healthy controls will be included.
